PACKMASTER-PACK_CORESET.title: Core Set
PACKMASTER-PACK_CORESET.description: The foundational Packmaster set featuring versatile tools and Synergy payoffs.
PACKMASTER-PACK_QUIET.title: Quiet
PACKMASTER-PACK_QUIET.description: Harness Unplayable, Retained, and Discarded cards to overpower your foes.
PACKMASTER-PACK_BITINGCOLD.title: Biting Cold
PACKMASTER-PACK_BITINGCOLD.description: Freeze enemies with Frostbite and capitalize on debuffs and relentless chills.
PACKMASTER-PACK_WARLOCK.title: Warlock
PACKMASTER-PACK_WARLOCK.description: Unleash demonic Exhaust payoffs, swarms of scaling Imps, and dark card draw.
PACKMASTER-PACK_EVENODD.title: Evens and Odds
PACKMASTER-PACK_EVENODD.description: Sequence your First, Odd, and Even cards each turn for amplified effects.
PACKMASTER-PACK_HIGHENERGY.title: High Energy
PACKMASTER-PACK_HIGHENERGY.description: Generate massive bursts of Energy and unleash devastating high-cost plays.
PACKMASTER-PACK_BATTER.title: Batter
PACKMASTER-PACK_BATTER.description: Line up devastating Critical Hits and snowball off massive unblocked attacks.
PACKMASTER-PACK_ENERGYANDECHO.title: Energy and Echo
PACKMASTER-PACK_ENERGYANDECHO.descriptio: Flood your turns with extra Energy and replay Echoing cards until you run dry.
PACKMASTER-PACK_SHAMAN.title: Shaman
PACKMASTER-PACK_SHAMAN.description: Command fire and frost with relentless Ignite burns, Scry, and next-turn payoffs.
PACKMASTER-PACK_WARDEN.title: Warden
PACKMASTER-PACK_WARDEN.description: Foresee and shape the top of your Draw Pile with Scry, setup plays, and Divine Might.
PACKMASTER-PACK_FARMER.title: Farmer
PACKMASTER-PACK_FARMER.description: Mix Attacks, Skills, Powers, and Status Fertilizers to reap multiplied harvests.
PACKMASTER-PACK_HERMIT.title: Hermit
PACKMASTER-PACK_HERMIT.description: Line up center-hand shots, turn self-debuffs into Strength, and claim deadly Bounties.
PACKMASTER-PACK_DISTORTION.title: Distortion
PACKMASTER-PACK_DISTORTION.description: Warp reality with Exhaust-triggered Distortion HP loss, Rue bursts, and Shatter combos.
PACKMASTER-BOUNTY_KEYWORD.title: Bounty
PACKMASTER-BOUNTY_KEYWORD.description: Gain [blue]15[/blue] Gold from a Normal enemy, [blue]40[/blue] from an Elite, or [blue]100[/blue] from a Boss.
PACKMASTER-ECHO_KEYWORD.title: Echo
PACKMASTER-ECHO_KEYWORD.description: Add a copy of this card with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-DRAFT_PAGE.description:
Choose your Packmaster Packs ([gold]{Pick}/{Total}[/gold]).
Active Packs: {ActiveList}
PACKMASTER-ACTIVE_PACKS_BUTTON.title: Active Packs
PACKMASTER-ACTIVE_PACKS_BUTTON.descripti:
View all cards in your active Packs:
[gold]{ActiveList}[/gold]
PACKMASTER-ACTIVE_PACKS_SCREEN.subtitleA: Showing {CardCount} cards across {PackCount} active Packs. Click any card to inspect.
DOWNFALL-DEAD_ON_KEYWORD.title: Dead On
DOWNFALL-DEAD_ON_KEYWORD.description: [gold]Dead On[/gold] cards have a bonus effect when in the middle of your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-ADAPT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to Exhaust for 8 Block each.
DOWNFALL-CHANT_KEYWORD.title: Chant
DOWNFALL-CHANT_KEYWORD.description: [gold]Chant[/gold] cards trigger a bonus effect for the rest of combat if the previous card you played was a [gold]Power[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CONJURE_KEYWORD.title: Conjure
DOWNFALL-CONJURE_KEYWORD.description: Add the next Spell from your Spellbook into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Playing 7 [gold]Powers[/gold] Awakens you, upgrading all Spells for the rest of combat.
DOWNFALL-SWAP_KEYWORD.title: Swap
DOWNFALL-SWAP_KEYWORD.description: Switch your active Gremlin with another living Gremlin in standby.
DOWNFALL-TEMP_HP_KEYWORD.title: Temp HP
DOWNFALL-TEMP_HP_KEYWORD.description: Temporary HP absorbs unblocked HP loss before your real HP.
DOWNFALL-ECHO_KEYWORD.title: Echo
DOWNFALL-ECHO_KEYWORD.description: Echoes are copies of cards with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. Echoes cannot be Echoed.
DOWNFALL-BERSERKER_STANCE_KEYWORD.title: Berserker Stance
DOWNFALL-DEFENSIVE_STANCE_KEYWORD.title: Defensive Stance
DOWNFALL-ULTIMATE_STANCE_KEYWORD.title: Ultimate Stance
DOWNFALL-ULTIMATE_STANCE_KEYWORD.descrip:
Counts as BOTH [gold]Berserker[/gold] and [gold]Defensive[/gold] Stances.
[gold]Skill Bonus[/gold] (3 charges): Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold] and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Counter[/gold].
[gold]Finisher Bonus[/gold]: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-FINISHER_KEYWORD.title: Finisher
DOWNFALL-FINISHER_KEYWORD.description: Can only be played while in a [gold]Stance[/gold]. Triggers your Stance's [gold]Finisher Bonus[/gold] and exits your Stance.
DOWNFALL-COMBO_KEYWORD.title: Combo
DOWNFALL-COMBO_KEYWORD.description: Triggers a bonus effect if you are in the matching [gold]Stance[/gold].
DOWNFALL-MUDDLE_KEYWORD.title: Muddle
DOWNFALL-MUDDLE_KEYWORD.description: Muddling a card changes its cost this turn to a different value between [blue]0[/blue] and [blue]3[/blue] at random.
DOWNFALL-OVERFLOW_KEYWORD.title: Overflow
DOWNFALL-OVERFLOW_KEYWORD.description: [gold]Overflow[/gold] effects activate if you have more than [blue]5[/blue] cards in [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-OFFCLASS_KEYWORD.title: Offclass
DOWNFALL-OFFCLASS_KEYWORD.description: An [gold]Offclass[/gold] card is any card from a card pool other than your own character's.
DOWNFALL-GIFT_KEYWORD.title: Gift
DOWNFALL-GIFT_KEYWORD.description: When you add this card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], choose an [gold]Offclass[/gold] card reward to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
DOWNFALL-LUCKY_KEYWORD.title: Lucky
DOWNFALL-LUCKY_KEYWORD.description: [gold]Overflow[/gold] effects always activate regardless of [gold]Hand[/gold] size.
DOWNFALL-SPLIT_KEYWORD.title: Split
DOWNFALL-SPLIT_KEYWORD.description: Spawn a Slime minion into an open Slime slot. If all slots are full, [gold]Absorb[/gold] your oldest Slime first.
DOWNFALL-COMMAND_KEYWORD.title: Command
DOWNFALL-COMMAND_KEYWORD.description: Your newest Slime minion immediately attacks.
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_KEYWORD.title: Absorb
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_KEYWORD.description: Remove a Slime minion to gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-TACKLE_KEYWORD.title: Tackle
DOWNFALL-TACKLE_KEYWORD.description: High-damage Attacks that also deal self-damage to you.
DOWNFALL-CONSUME_KEYWORD.title: Consume
DOWNFALL-CONSUME_KEYWORD.description: Triggers a bonus effect when attacking an enemy that has [gold]Goop[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BRACE_KEYWORD.title: Brace
DOWNFALL-BRACE_KEYWORD.description: Reduce your [gold]Mode Shift[/gold] counter to enter [gold]Defensive Mode[/gold] sooner.
DOWNFALL-STASIS_KEYWORD.title: Stasis
DOWNFALL-STASIS_KEYWORD.description: Suspend a card in a [gold]Stasis[/gold] slot for turns equal to its cost + [blue]1[/blue]. When released, it returns to your [gold]Hand[/gold] costing [blue]0[/blue] until played.
DOWNFALL-ACCELERATE_KEYWORD.title: Accelerate
DOWNFALL-ACCELERATE_KEYWORD.description: Reduce the turn counter of your oldest [gold]Stasis[/gold] card by [blue]1[/blue].
DOWNFALL-VOLATILE_KEYWORD.title: Volatile
DOWNFALL-VOLATILE_KEYWORD.description: When released from [gold]Stasis[/gold], this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] instead of returning to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-GEM_KEYWORD.title: Gem
DOWNFALL-GEM_KEYWORD.description: Can be socketed into open card sockets at Rest Sites to permanently add its effect to that card.
DOWNFALL-HEXA_AFTERLIFE.title: Afterlife
DOWNFALL-HEXA_AFTERLIFE.description: Triggers its [gold]Afterlife[/gold] effect whenever this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
DOWNFALL-HEXA_GHOSTFLAME.title: Ghostflame
DOWNFALL-HEXA_GHOSTFLAME.description: The [gold]Active[/gold] Ghostflame can be [gold]Ignited[/gold] by meeting its Ignition requirement. At the end of your turn, if it is [gold]Ignited[/gold], [gold]Advance[/gold] to the next Ghostflame.
DOWNFALL-HEXA_IGNITE.title: Ignite
DOWNFALL-HEXA_IGNITE.description: Triggers the Ignition effect of a Ghostflame.
DOWNFALL-HEXA_ADVANCE.title: Advance
DOWNFALL-HEXA_ADVANCE.description: Move to the next Ghostflame and [gold]Extinguish[/gold] it.
DOWNFALL-HEXA_RETRACT.title: Retract
DOWNFALL-HEXA_RETRACT.description: Move to the previous Ghostflame and [gold]Extinguish[/gold] it.
DOWNFALL-HEXA_EXTINGUISH.title: Extinguish
DOWNFALL-HEXA_EXTINGUISH.description: Resets a Ghostflame so it can be [gold]Ignited[/gold] again.
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_ENCODE.title: Encode
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_ENCODE.description: Add this card to your [gold]Function[/gold] sequence. When [blue]3[/blue] cards are [gold]Encoded[/gold], their effects merge into a [blue]1[/blue]-cost [gold]Function[/gold] card.
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_COMPILE.title: Compile
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_COMPILE.description: An effect that triggers when this card is merged into a [gold]Function[/gold]. Negative effects are referred to as Compile [red]Errors[/red].
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_INSERT.title: Insert
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_INSERT.description: Shuffle a card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_CYCLE.title: Cycle
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_CYCLE.description: Discard a card, drawing a new card to replace it.
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_BLUR.title: Blur
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_BLUR.description: Do not lose [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_PYRE.title: Pyre
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_PYRE.description: Requires [gold]Exhausting[/gold] another card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] to play.
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_PYRE.selectPrompt: Choose a card from your Hand to Pyre (Exhaust).
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_AFFLICTED.title: Afflicted
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_AFFLICTED.description: An enemy with both [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. [gold]Doom[/gold] is not removed when it triggers on an [gold]Afflicted[/gold] enemy.
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_COLLECTED.title: Collected
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_COLLECTED.description: A soul claimed into your [gold]Collection[/gold]. Each turn, you draw a card from your [gold]Collection[/gold]. Collected cards [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_TORCHHEAD.title: Torchhead
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_TORCHHEAD.description: While you have [gold]Temp HP[/gold], your Torchhead triggers its gained effects whenever you play an Attack.
DOWNFALL-COLLECTOR_COLLECTION_STATUS.des:
Essence: [blue]{Essence}[/blue]
Collected cards: [blue]{Count}[/blue]
Spend [blue]3[/blue] Essence after combat to claim a [gold]Collected[/gold] card.
